en: I prepared dinner early today.

lat: ma wejjednash bitza kbira l d-drari

en: You do not prepare your lessons on time.

lat: ntuma katwejjdu l-mektab dyalkum kul nhar
ar: نتوما كتوجدو المكتب ديالكم كل نهار
en: You prepare your desk every day.

I am going to prepare chicken tagine tonight.
I am not going to prepare food today.
You are going to prepare the documents tomorrow.

lat: nti ghadi twejjdi l-7rira f l-3shiya
en: You (f.) are going to prepare harira in the evening.
You are not going to prepare the suitcase tonight.

lat: huwa ghadi ywejjed l-khebz f l-kuzina
en: He is going to prepare bread in the kitchen.

lat: ma ghadish ywejjed atay l d-dyaf
en: He is not going to prepare tea for the guests.

lat: hiya ghadi twejjed l-3sha l wladha
en: She is going to prepare dinner for her children.

lat: ma ghadish nwejjdu l-makla f d-dar
en: We are not going to prepare food at home.

lat: ntuma ghadi twejjdu l-bit l l-mudir
en: You are going to prepare the room for the director.

lat: huma ghadi ywejjdu s-sendwishat l d-drari
en: They are going to prepare sandwiches for the children.

lat: ma ghadish ywejjdu t-tumubil l s-sefr
en: They are not going to prepare the car for travel.
